state.instructions: You are given one record of a network flow, described by the columns listed below. Decide whether the flow is an intrusion attempt or normal traffic, and which category it belongs to. Labeled example records may be provided; use them as reference. Judge the record by its own values: do not assume a category is present only because it appears among the examples.

categories.DoS: denial of service from one host, an attempt to make a web server too busy to serve legitimate requests, by flooding it or by holding its connections open with slow requests.
categories.DDoS: distributed denial of service, many hosts flooding one server with requests at the same time.
categories.PortScan: scanning that probes many ports of a host to find which services are open.
categories.BruteForce: repeated login attempts against a service such as FTP or SSH, guessing passwords.
categories.Botnet: an infected host talking to the command-and-control server of a botnet.

is_attack.instructions: Is the flow `flows.under_test` an intrusion attempt rather than normal traffic? Judge it by `instructions` and `columns`, and by the labeled `examples` when they are present.

category.instructions: Which category in `categories` does the flow `flows.under_test` belong to?
